requirements.title: 18-Page Graphic Novel Sample
requirements.definition: Produce an 18-page comic or graphic-novel script sample adapted from the supplied screenplay material and suitable for presentation to artists and potential crowdfunding backers.
requirements.boundary_note: The page count, selected story segment, and presentation purpose are attributes of one sample deliverable; panel-level formatting and editorial fidelity are independently assessable behaviors represented separately.

requirements.title: Panel-Based Sample Script Format
requirements.definition: Structure the sample as a professional comic script organized by pages and panels, with dialogue, captions, and visual direction while leaving precise balloon placement to the artist.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the structural representation of the sample, not its page count, story coverage, or the degree of permitted adaptation from the screenplay.

requirements.title: Creative Discretion in Sample Adaptation
requirements.definition: Allow the adapter to adjust pacing and presentation rather than reproduce the screenplay line-for-line, including converting scene description into voice-over captions and omitting minor exchanges when appropriate.
requirements.boundary_note: The permitted transformations are aspects of one editorial-discretion rule; this rule can change independently of the sample length and panel-based format.

requirements.title: Full-Length Graphic Novel Adaptation
requirements.definition: Create a prospective 96–102-page comic-script adaptation using the supplied scripts and novel, with the exact story coverage and narrative endpoint to be determined within the page limit.
requirements.boundary_note: This is separate from the completed sample because it is a distinct future deliverable that can be deferred independently. Page count, source selection, story coverage, and ending treatment are attributes of that one adaptation task rather than separate Requirements.

unresolved_candidates.description: The full-length adaptation is identifiable, but its authoritative source, exact story coverage, and self-contained-versus-cliffhanger ending remain unresolved values for later lifecycle annotation.
